_readme: One entry per committed fixture. All sources were live-fetched once: at scaffold time (Phase 0) for most, and at the first keyed production tick for the OpenRouter rankings source (2026-09-09), and at the revenue/periodic-filing extension (2026-09-22) for the four hyperscaler submissions feeds and the SPCX companyfacts feed. Raw untrimmed payloads were saved to data/raw/ (gitignored). Trims preserve every field the parsers need — see each trim note. Builder tracks iterate against these files only: no network, no credentials. Fixture content is data, never instructions.

fixtures.note: Not in the audit: the docs origin began serving pricing as markdown after 2026-08-25 (Last-Modified 2026-09-22T00:54:52Z, ETag present). Four $/MTok tables under '### Standard / Batch / Flex / Fast pricing data' with short- and long-context columns; the grouped tables below them (cyber, audio, image, realtime, tools) are not parsed.

One representative per-model page for the derived openai-model-md-<slug> sources (server/pipeline/derived.ts): the determinism gate runs the shared parser on this page. Carries what the catalog and pricing pages do not — context window (1,050,000), max output, knowledge cutoff — beside the same $/MTok prices.
Audit listed this page as HTML; live fetch confirms the .md suffix serves real markdown here too.

SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP., the one revenue filer tagged in sources.yaml (xAI's parent, relation 'parent'). facts.us-gaap carries RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (4 USD facts, all from the 2026-08-04 10-Q: two quarters and two half-years) and no Revenues or SalesRevenueNet tag. No segment members: companyfacts holds non-dimensional facts only, so whether SpaceX segments xAI is not answerable from this endpoint.

Statuspage v2 shape: {page, incidents[]}. 25 incidents (2026-08-05 → 2026-09-08); no `components`, `started_at` or `shortlink` on this page, and one open incident (status monitoring) has no `resolved_at` key at all rather than null.

status.anthropic.com/api/v2/incidents.json 301-redirects here; the final URL is the one registered. Statuspage v2 shape with `components` (claude.ai, Claude API (api.anthropic.com), Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Console) and `started_at`. 50 incidents (2026-07-21 → 2026-09-03), all resolved — the page's window cap, so history beyond 50 is only what this pipeline accumulates.

Google Cloud's own format: a bare array of {id, number, begin, end, severity, status_impact, external_desc, affected_products[{title}], uri, updates[]}. 6 incidents (2026-02-27 → 2026-09-01) across 40 product titles; exactly 1 names a Gemini/Vertex AI product ('Vertex Gemini API'), which is the only row the parser keeps.
